title: Yamuna Expressway opened
summary: The 165-km six-lane corridor became the enduring access spine for YEIDA.
impact: Already embedded in current land and housing values; future widening is separate.

title: Jaypee Sports City master allotment cancelled
summary: YEIDA cancelled the approximately 1,000-hectare master allotment after dues and compliance failures.
impact: Demonstrates that a very large allotment and iconic asset do not guarantee residential conversion.

title: Yotta D1 inaugurated in Greater Noida
summary: A 28.8-MW, 5,000-rack data-centre building entered operation.
impact: Real regional digital infrastructure, distinct from YEIDA's failed original data-centre park.

title: AISATS selected for the airport cargo hub
summary: The airport selected AISATS to design, build, finance and operate the multimodal cargo hub.
impact: Converted the cargo concept into a named operator commitment.

title: Avery Dennison YEIDA facility became operational
summary: Production evidence moved this Sector 32 facility beyond allotment and construction.
impact: Actual employment-demand evidence, though local headcount remains undisclosed.

title: Surya Global Flexi Films began production
summary: The Sector 29 flexible-packaging unit entered production.
impact: Verified industrial conversion rather than a job promise.

title: Vivo started production in YEIDA
summary: The large Sector 24A smartphone plant moved into production.
impact: One of the corridor's strongest existing employment anchors; Dixon JV changes must not double count it.

title: Film City concession signed
summary: The third tender finally produced a signed concession after two failed rounds.
impact: A real contractual milestone, but not construction or employment.

title: Purvanchal and Eldeco won Sector 22D housing parcels
summary: YEIDA's group-housing auction generated verified land-price evidence.
impact: Supports land-cost modelling but not apartment sales or occupancy.

title: Film City Phase 1 site handed over
summary: YEIDA handed the 230-acre Phase 1 site to the concessionaire.
impact: Land conversion advanced, but finance and physical mobilisation remained unresolved.

title: Electronics Manufacturing Cluster 2.0 approved
summary: Government approved the Sector 10 cluster infrastructure programme.
impact: Cluster infrastructure became credible; individual company LoIs still required conversion.

title: Greenbay cancellation notice issued
summary: YEIDA moved against the legacy Sector 22D township over dues; court restraint followed.
impact: Legacy 22D inventory requires title, dues and registry checks rather than rate comparison alone.

title: Special industrial parks remained weakly converted
summary: Authority surveys showed many allotments but few leases, buildings or operating units across apparel, toy, MSME and medical-device parks.
impact: Cluster job totals remain aspirations until facility-level conversion is evidenced.

title: Thirty-nine industrial plots cancelled
summary: Allottees failed to execute lease deeds after notice.
impact: Allotment letters alone materially overstate investment conversion.

title: Sector 22D power reliability failure reported
summary: Only 13 of 21 transformers reportedly functioned for roughly 300 resident families.
impact: Direct liveability and rental-demand discount despite premium project launches.

title: Noida Airport received DGCA aerodrome licence
summary: The airport crossed its final major aviation-regulatory gate.
impact: Removed a major binary execution risk shortly before opening.

title: India Chip semiconductor facility broke ground
summary: The HCL-Foxconn OSAT/ATMP project moved from approval into physical execution.
impact: Credible specialised employment pipeline, but commissioning remains complex.

title: AM Group AI/HPC hub LoIs announced
summary: A 289-acre, Rs 2.2-lakh-crore proposal entered the formal-interest funnel.
impact: Potentially transformative, but no lease, possession, finance or construction evidence yet.

title: Noida International Airport opened
summary: The first scheduled passenger flight converted the airport from construction story to operating infrastructure.
impact: Strongest realised catalyst in the corridor; actual traffic should now replace design capacity in valuation.

title: First dedicated cargo flight operated
summary: The airport cargo hub entered commercial use.
impact: Supports logistics and rental demand, but actual tonnage remains unavailable.

title: Large solar and IT allotment letters issued
summary: CESC, Integrated Batteries and several IT/ITES firms received allotment letters.
impact: Formal land-pipeline progress; leases, possession and construction remain the conversion test.

title: Botanical Garden-Sector 142 metro funded
summary: Union Cabinet approved the 11.56-km extension; L&T was later selected.
impact: Material network integration for Noida, but indirect for Sector 22D.

title: Ghaziabad-Jewar Namo Bharat remained at DPR
summary: A preliminary 72.5-km corridor was disclosed without sanction, funding or civil work.
impact: Potentially transformative but earns little present-value credit.

title: Airport-Ganga Expressway link approved
summary: UP Cabinet cleared a 74.5-km, Rs 8,585.51-crore corridor.
impact: Long-term logistics upside; acquisition and construction remain.

title: Film City financial closure still pending
summary: Despite concession and land handover, financial closure and substantive construction remained outstanding.
impact: Film City should remain heavily discounted in current housing valuation.

title: Official YEIDA OneMap plot layers ingested
summary: The report exported privacy-safe non-residential planning polygons through YEIDA's citizen browser context.
impact: Users can now click official YEIDA industrial, commercial, institutional and mixed-use plots.
